mechanism: Galantamine (cholinesterase inhibitor) enhances acetylcholine effects, which may potentiate muscarinic and nicotinic effects, while fluphenazine (typical antipsychotic) has anticholinergic properties that can antagonize these effects and increase CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for additive CNS depression, extrapyramidal symptoms, and anticholinergic effects; ensure adequate oversight in elderly patients with cognitive impairment; consider alternative antipsychotic if significant anticholinergic burden.
